title: 第3章 杨开彬第4章 执法长老死了
slug: 谁让这小子升执法长老的
content_zh:
“你给小爷站住，要不然给我抓到，我定你生不如死。”后面那个人，一副戏谑的表情，身上也有着一股自信。
那种自信，是一种对他人命运生杀予夺培养出来的。
“休想，杨开彬，你别以为有你表哥撑腰，你就可以为所欲为，强的是你表哥，不是你，要不是你偷袭，我定斩你。”逃跑的男生还回头，看了杨开彬一眼，眼里的恨意非常浓郁。
“斩我，开玩笑，你先从我手底下逃出去再说吧，留下灵石，我还能让你死得痛快点。”杨开彬追赶着。
很快，他们就看到了曹立带头的执法巡逻队。
前面逃的人，看到执法巡逻队，只是撇了一眼，那一眼，带着冷漠，带着无视。
他虽重伤，却不会求助于执法巡逻队的人，根本就无用。
背后的杨开彬，可是有背景的，他没有背景，找执法队，无非就是和解，执法队也不敢重罚杨开彬，有什么用？
等下俩人和解，出了执法堂，杨开彬绝对继续找他麻烦。
前面逃跑的人，速度更快，无视了执法队，直接离开。
而杨开彬也看到执法巡逻队了。
也无视了。
执法巡逻队算个鸟啊，他表哥可是亲传弟子葛颜。
表哥身后站着的，可是长老。
四舍五入，他的身后，也是有长老撑腰的，怕什么执法堂，搞笑。
杨开彬和走在最前面的曹立对视一眼，直接无视的走开。
还不忘大吼一句：“没人能够保你。”
曹立皱眉，这小子这么猖狂。
曹立没记错的话，这个人就是调戏白忆，也就是调戏二队相好的那个人吧？
这才半天没见，就在这里追杀人了？

见到的就已经是这样了，没见到的呢？
这个人仗着背后有人撑腰，真的是无法无天啊。
曹立拍了拍身边小弟的肩膀：“小虎，过去把那个人叫过来。”
小虎一看清对方的容貌，立马露出怯意。“曹哥，这个人是亲传弟子葛颜的表弟。”
曹立皱眉：“表弟怎么了，表弟就可以当街行凶吗？”
小虎干咳两声，猫着腰，有点怂：“这不一样，曹哥，亲传弟子，背后都是有长老在撑腰的，得罪他们，对咱们一点好处都没有啊。”
“这种人，咱们开罪不起啊。”其他小弟附和道。
曹立皱眉：“咱们今天干啥来了？”
环视了五个小弟，一个个一言不发。
说的时候，确实热血，但真正去做起来，还是很难的，他们没那个胆。
“小虎，你去，把他拦下来，今天无论如何，他都必须跟我们回执法堂。”
见小虎还是有点怂。
曹立大喝一声：“别忘记了，本队今天是来给你们撑腰的，不管任何后果，我一力承担。”
“是！”小虎这才喊道。
“你们俩个，跟我一起走。”小虎点了两人，三人齐齐朝那杨开彬追去。
路过的人，诧异的看着曹立等六人，露出诧异的神色。
“莫不是那葛颜犯了什么事情了？执法堂居然敢动他表弟？真是怪事。”一群人路上走着。
曹立慢慢走过去，看着杨开彬追着那个受伤的人到一个竹林里。
而小虎已经飞快的跑过去了。
同为练气，速度都是差不多了，小虎很快就追到了。

此时，那个受伤的人，已经筋疲力尽，在竹林里停了下来，准备依靠地势，和杨开彬拼了。
就算杀不了他，也要狠狠的咬下杨开彬的一块肉。
那个人停了下来，从腰间抽出一把剑，冷冷的看着杨开彬。
杨开彬停了下来，戏谑的调侃道：“跑啊，怎么不跑了。”
“杨开彬你不得好死。”
content_en:
"You stand still, young master, or if you catch me, I will make sure your life is worse than death." The man behind had a joking expression and a sense of confidence about him.
That kind of self-confidence is cultivated by taking over the fate of others.
"Don't think about it, Yang Kaibin, don't think that with your cousin's support, you can do whatever you want. It's your cousin who is stronger, not you. If you hadn't attacked me by surprise, I would have killed you." The boy who ran away turned around and glanced at Yang Kaibin, the hatred in his eyes was very strong.
"Kill me, you're kidding. You should escape from my hands first. Leave the spirit stone behind, and I can make you die a quick death." Yang Kaibin chased after him.
Soon, they saw the law enforcement patrol led by Cao Li.
The people fleeing in front just glanced at the law enforcement patrol, with indifference and disregard.
Although he was seriously injured, he would not seek help from the law enforcement patrol, so it would be useless.
Yang Kaibin behind the scenes has a background. He has no background. He goes to the law enforcement team, which is nothing more than reconciliation. The law enforcement team doesn't dare to punish Yang Kaibin severely. What's the use?
After the two reconciled and left the law enforcement hall, Yang Kaibin would definitely continue to cause trouble for him.
The people escaping in front were faster, ignored the law enforcement team, and left directly.
And Yang Kaibin also saw the law enforcement patrol team.
Also ignored.
The law enforcement patrol team is nothing, but his cousin is his direct disciple Ge Yan.
The person standing behind my cousin is an elder.
Rounding things off, he also has the support of elders behind him. He is afraid of the law enforcement hall, which is funny.
Yang Kaibin and Cao Li, who was walking at the front, looked at each other and walked away indifferently.
Not forgetting to yell: "No one can protect you."
Cao Li frowned, this kid is so arrogant.
If Cao Li remembered correctly, this person was the one who was teasing Bai Yi, the one who was teasing his best friend from the second team, right?
We haven’t seen each other for a long time, and you’re chasing someone here?
That’s what you’ve seen. What about the ones you haven’t seen?
This person is really lawless with the support of someone behind him.
Cao Li patted the younger brother next to him on the shoulder: "Xiaohu, go over and call that person over."
As soon as Xiaohu saw the other party's appearance clearly, he immediately showed timidity. "Brother Cao, this man is the cousin of his direct disciple Ge Yan."
Cao Li frowned: "What's wrong with my cousin? Can my cousin commit murder on the street?"
Xiaohu coughed twice, hunched over, a little timid: "This is different, Brother Cao, the direct disciples are all supported by elders. Offending them will not do us any good."
"We can't afford to offend this kind of person." The other boys agreed.
Cao Li frowned: "What are we doing here today?"
He looked around at the five younger brothers, none of them said a word.
When I say it, I am really enthusiastic, but it is still difficult to actually do it. They don't have the courage.
"Xiaohu, go and stop him. No matter what today, he must return to the law enforcement hall with us."
Seeing Xiaohu is still a bit timid.
Cao Li shouted: "Don't forget, our team is here to support you today. No matter what the consequences are, I will bear them."
"Yes!" Xiaohu shouted.
"You two, come with me." Xiaohu ordered the two of them, and the three of them chased Yang Kaibin.
People passing by looked at Cao Li and the other six people with surprised expressions.
"Did that Ge Yan commit something? How dare the Law Enforcement Hall touch his cousin? It's really weird." A group of people were walking on the road.
Cao Li walked over slowly and watched Yang Kaibin chasing the injured man into a bamboo forest.
But Xiaohu had already ran over quickly.
They were both practicing Qi, so their speeds were almost the same, so Xiaohu caught up quickly.
At this time, the injured man was exhausted and stopped in the bamboo forest, ready to rely on the terrain to fight Yang Kaibin.
Even if you can't kill him, you still have to bite off a piece of Yang Kaibin's flesh.
The man stopped and raised his hand from the waistHe took out a sword and looked at Yang Kaibin coldly.
Yang Kaibin stopped and joked: "Run, why don't you run away."
"Yang Kaibin, you must die a good death."
